description: This file defines a RecyclerView Adapter named SimpleRowAdapter used for rendering a list of rows, each with a title and subtitle, in an Android application's UI.

classes.name: SimpleRowAdapter
classes.description: An adapter for RecyclerView that manages a list of RowItem objects and binds them to item views.

classes.name: VH
classes.description: ViewHolder class that holds references to the title and subtitle TextViews for a single row item.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the item layout and creates a VH instance.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data from a RowItem to the views in the ViewHolder.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of items in the data set.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Replaces the current data set with a new list of RowItems and notifies the adapter of data change.
